record.title: Prepare one settled stock observation after the completed removal
record.intent: Distinguish an early process-readiness stop from the settled stock software state.
requirements: Preserve and independently review the completed stopped final-stock02 run, removal intent/completion, exactly one normal reboot, new captured REQUEST-ACK, UID2000 and failed first pidof. Preserve partial client outcomes and recorder drop statistics. Do not assert a stock process, UI, policy or successful original transition from the stopped prefix.

Create a separate narrowly changed stock-only successor of the accepted postboot observer. Bind the stopped removal authority, original introduction, protected baseline, previous policy file and the new captured lease. Retain complete stock APK and packaged-native mapping, sidecar absence, status/corpus validation, one UID-first connection and at most one still-unused conditional root with a distinct postroot readiness sequence.

Observe only the present settled stock boot with no deployment, removal, reboot, reset, settings, RF, entitlement or calibration action. Require boot differs from the prior derived epoch, 60-second serviced settling, 1801-second serviced warm-up, two reviewed normal UI witnesses, fixed16 stock17-17 and final same-epoch preservation. Keep the finite05:20UTC cap,3000 native maximum and120 cleanup. Replace the obsolete future-RF-plus-rollback reserve with at least2400 seconds for this observation.

Run focused positive and negative supplied-file controls for wrong removal/lease/arm/cap/reserve and one-shot lifecycle restrictions, plus strict types and formatting. Freeze the complete binding, completed-input reader and host-only staging/pin/namespace validation without contacting the specimen. Preserve earlier artifacts unchanged.
acceptance: A concrete finite stock-only observation or an explicit preparation blocker is preserved.
